Subject: Re: Renewal window + mid-contract capacity top-up

Samir — thanks for the context and the RFP. I put together three practical paths below (high level) and attached a pricing matrix and a draft amendment for legal.

Option 1 — Incremental monthly top-up (no co-term change)
- Add X reserved units per month for the quarter (Aug–Oct example scaled to Q4).
- No change to contract end date. Top-ups billed monthly; no term extension.
- Discount: standard add-on discount (5%) for volumes under 200k units/mo.

Option 2 — Staged top-up + co-term (recommended for predictability)
- Purchase staged committed units for the remainder of year (3 tranches: Oct/Nov/Dec) and annualize at renewal to a new baseline.
- Invoice: one upfront for the staged commitment or split into 2 invoices (50/50) — flexible.
- Discount: stepped discount (7% once cumulative >600k tokens in the quarter).

Option 3 — Upfront bridge + co-term acceleration
- One-time upfront purchase to cover spike, then rebalance at renewal (co-term moves to next Mar 31 if annualization chosen).
- Higher discount for upfront (10% on the bridge amount) but requires PO at signing.

Trade-offs and notes:
- If procurement requires monthly invoices for budget reasons, we can simulate monthly billing while keeping a committed annual amount (invoiced monthly but commitment still counted).
- Legal prefers a single short amendment (attached) to avoid full contract redraft.

Attachments: pricing_matrix_q3_v2.xlsx, draft_amendment_topup.docx

Next steps:
1) Tell me which of the three you prefer and the approximate committed units for Q4.
2) If procurement insists on a specific invoicing cadence, flag it and I’ll include the exact invoice language.

I’m free Monday to walk through with procurement.

— Karthik

- We need a short one-page summary for the CFO describing: effective start date, monthly invoice amount, and renewal baseline step.

Can you:
- Provide a single-page summary for Option 2 showing monthly invoice splits and the renewal baseline calculation?
- Confirm the discount bands if we commit to the staged tranches today (600k+ tokens / quarter triggers 7%).

If you can send that by EOD Wednesday, procurement will route the PO.

Samir
